authentication_sessions_revocation_check.name: authentication_sessions_revocation_check
authentication_sessions_revocation_check.value:
("authentication_sessions"."status" = 'active' and "authentication_sessions"."revoked_at" is null and "authentication_sessions"."revocation_reason" is null and "authentication_sessions"."replaced_by_session_id" is null)
        or ("authentication_sessions"."status" = 'revoked' and "authentication_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null and "authentication_sessions"."revocation_reason" is not null and "authentication_sessions"."revoked_at" >= "authentication_sessions"."created_at")
        or ("authentication_sessions"."status" = 'expired' and "authentication_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null and "authentication_sessions"."revocation_reason" = 'expired' and "authentication_sessions"."replaced_by_session_id" is null)

membership_role_assignments_lifecycle_ti.name: membership_role_assignments_lifecycle_timestamps_check
membership_role_assignments_lifecycle_ti.value: ("membership_role_assignments"."lifecycle_status" = 'active' and "membership_role_assignments"."revoked_at" is null) or ("membership_role_assignments"."lifecycle_status" = 'revoked' and "membership_role_assignments"."revoked_at" is not null and "membership_role_assignments"."revoked_at" >= "membership_role_assignments"."assigned_at")

mfa_challenges_verification_check.name: mfa_challenges_verification_check
mfa_challenges_verification_check.value:
("mfa_challenges"."status" = 'verified' and "mfa_challenges"."verified_at" is not null)
        or ("mfa_challenges"."status" <> 'verified' and "mfa_challenges"."verified_at" is null)

organization_memberships_lifecycle_times.name: organization_memberships_lifecycle_timestamps_check
organization_memberships_lifecycle_times.value:
("organization_memberships"."status" = 'invited' and "organization_memberships"."activated_at" is null and "organization_memberships"."suspended_at" is null and "organization_memberships"."revoked_at" is null)
        or ("organization_memberships"."status" = 'active' and "organization_memberships"."activated_at" is not null and "organization_memberships"."suspended_at" is null and "organization_memberships"."revoked_at" is null)
        or ("organization_memberships"."status" = 'suspended' and "organization_memberships"."activated_at" is not null and "organization_memberships"."suspended_at" is not null and "organization_memberships"."revoked_at" is null)
        or ("organization_memberships"."status" = 'revoked' and "organization_memberships"."revoked_at" is not null)

roles_disabled_at_check.name: roles_disabled_at_check
roles_disabled_at_check.value: ("roles"."lifecycle_status" = 'active' and "roles"."disabled_at" is null) or ("roles"."lifecycle_status" = 'disabled' and "roles"."disabled_at" is not null)

totp_enrollments_lifecycle_check.name: totp_enrollments_lifecycle_check
totp_enrollments_lifecycle_check.value:
("totp_enrollments"."status" = 'pending' and "totp_enrollments"."verified_at" is null and "totp_enrollments"."disabled_at" is null)
        or ("totp_enrollments"."status" = 'active' and "totp_enrollments"."verified_at" is not null and "totp_enrollments"."disabled_at" is null)
        or ("totp_enrollments"."status" = 'disabled' and "totp_enrollments"."disabled_at" is not null)
